name: Ryan Maifield
palmares: Multi-time ROAR National Champion; multiple IFMAR Worlds podiums (2WD/4WD); ex-Team Associated, now Tekno RC factory driver
notes: Official 'Ryan Maifield Momentum' YouTube channel plus a 'Pro Pit Tip' explainer (indoor 2WD setup). Historic event setup sheets via Team Associated; current Tekno buggy/truggy setups circulate via the Tekno community. Content is video + changing event sheets, not a fixed guide.

name: Ty Tessmann
palmares: 2014 IFMAR 1/8 Nitro Buggy World Champion; multiple ROAR titles; ex-HB Racing, now Xray factory driver
notes: Personal site hosts a large organized downloadable setup-sheet archive (XB8, XB8E, XB4, XB2, older HB D815) tied to specific events. A changing event-sheet archive (latest visible ~2021), not a fixed published guide.

name: Spencer Rivkin
palmares: 2016 ROAR 1/8 Nitro Off-Road National Champion; 2019 IFMAR 1/10 Electric Off-Road Worlds competitor; Team Associated factory driver
notes: Team Associated 'Reedy Race Spotlight' pages narrate his winning B6D and RC8B3 setups with rationale (actionable). Downloadable event sheets via CML Distribution. Event-specific changing pages, not a fixed guide.

name: Davide Ongaro
palmares: Multi-time IFMAR 1/8 IC Off-Road World Champion; Team Associated factory driver (RC8B4.1 'Ongaro Edition' signature kit)
notes: Signature RC8B4.1 'Ongaro Edition' kit ships spec'd to his championship setup (kit base sheet is the closest to a fixed reference). Event sheets appear via CML Distribution. Relies on manufacturer/distributor hosting rather than a personal hub.

name: Jared Tebo
palmares: Multi-time IFMAR World Champion and ROAR National Champion; long-time Kyosho factory driver
notes: Personal site 'JTP RC' hosts downloadable PDF setup sheets across Kyosho/Tekno platforms (EB48, NB48, NT48, MP9/MP9e, STRR) — last refreshed ~2022. Kyosho America publishes his event setups via LiveRC. Changing event sheets + video, not a fixed guide.

name: Cody King
palmares: 2010 IFMAR 1/8 Nitro Off-Road World Champion; Kyosho / Byron's factory driver
notes: Weakest verification. No dedicated driver setup-sheet hub. Generic Hobbywing off-road team-sheet page plus third-party 'Under the Hood' (NeoBuggy) and RC Car Action interviews — editorial insight, not his own published setups.

name: Ryan Cavalieri
palmares: Multi-time IFMAR 1/10 Electric Off-Road World Champion; multiple ROAR titles; Team Associated factory driver
notes: Dedicated CML Distribution driver page (#76) with many downloadable event setup sheets (C4.1, B44 series, RC8.2, B6), plus Reedy Race Spotlight pages narrating winning B6 and SC5M setups. Changing event sheets / editorial spotlights, not a fixed guide.

name: Dakotah Phend
palmares: ROAR National Champion (2WD/4WD); IFMAR Worlds competitor; TLR / Team Losi Racing factory driver
notes: TLR official setup-sheet repository hosts his event sheets (e.g. directly-linked Desert Classic 22 5.0 PDF, JC Fall Nats, Florida Carpet Champs). PetitRC mirrors Losi 22 4.0/5.0 sheets. Event-specific downloadable sheets, not a fixed guide.

name: Lee Martin
palmares: 4x EFRA European Champion; 2013 IFMAR Vice World Champion; longtime Schumacher 1/10 off-road factory driver
notes: Event-specific, surface-specific (astro/carpet/dry) downloadable setup sheets for Schumacher CAT L1R and Cougar LD3 on Schumacher's official technical-information pages and CML Distribution. Data-only sheets, no prose tuning theory; not a fixed guide.

name: Neil Cragg
palmares: 2005 IFMAR 1/10 Electric Off-Road 2WD World Champion (RC10B4); multiple UK/European podiums; longtime Team Associated factory driver
notes: Downloadable Team Associated (B6/RC10B7/RC8B4.1) event setup sheets via CML Distribution and PetitRC. RedRC 'Chassis Focus' interview details chassis/component choices but is editorial. Sheets are data-only.

name: David Ronnefalk
palmares: IFMAR 1/8 Nitro Buggy World Champion; HB Racing factory driver
notes: Strongest video tuning educator of the off-road group. 'Pro Tips by David Ronnefalk' YouTube series: steering plates to tune handling, shock build, brake assembly, turnbuckles, .8 mod gears, D819 setup walkthrough. Personal site aggregates his channels; HB Racing hosts his editable team sheets. Video/sheets, not a fixed guide.

name: Bruno Coelho
palmares: 2019 IFMAR 1/10 Electric Off-Road 4WD World Champion; multiple IFMAR Touring World titles; XRAY factory driver
notes: Competes at the top in BOTH off-road and touring. XRAY runs an official searchable setup portal (setup.teamxray.com) hosting his XB4 buggy and touring sheets. World-winning XB4 sheets published via LiveRC. EFRA hosts a 'Top Setup Tips' prose article under his name. Sheets are data-only; no fixed book.

name: Michal Orlowski
palmares: 4x EOS Champion; 2x EFRA European Champion; multiple IFMAR Worlds medalist; 2017 BRCA GT12 World Champion; Schumacher factory driver
notes: Schumacher driver. Personal site morlowski.pl is a social aggregator + racing-philosophy hub (8 principles), no setup sheets hosted there. Actual setup sheets released through Schumacher channels (ETS sheets on Facebook) and EOS 'Chassis Focus'. Tuning content is scattered, not centralized or fixed.

name: Robert Batlle
palmares: IFMAR 1/8 Nitro Buggy World Champion (MBX7, Argentina); multiple European titles; Mugen Seiki factory driver
notes: Mugen's US distributor (mugenracing.com/setup-sheets) hosts downloadable Robert Batlle sheets (MBX8, Silverstate MBX-7R, MBX-7R Eco). Worlds-winning MBX7 setup via LiveRC. Data-only 1/8 nitro/e-buggy sheets; no fixed guide.

name: Juho Levanen
palmares: Multiple European Champion; IFMAR Vice World Champion (1/12); Team Associated factory driver
notes: Weakest verification. Confirmed Team Associated factory driver via RC Car Action editorial, but no driver-specific published setup sheet, personal site, or YouTube tuning channel attributable to him was found. CML Distribution hosts Associated team sheets generally but no Levanen-attributed sheet confirmed.

name: Ronald Volker
palmares: IFMAR ISTC Touring Car World Champion; 9x EFRA European Champion; multiple ETS titles; Yokomo factory driver
notes: Yokomo's official download page (current) hosts his event setup sheets (ETS BD9/BD8). Named contributing World Champion in the published 264-page 'Essential Touring Car RC Racer's Guide' (Dave B Stevens) — a FIXED citable guide. ETS 'Chassis Focus' documents his car config.

name: Marc Rheinard
palmares: 3x IFMAR ISTC Touring Car World Champion; 2020 IFMAR 1/12 World Champion; multiple ETS titles; founder of MR33
notes: Lead contributing World Champion in the published 'Essential Touring Car RC Racer's Guide' (FIXED, citable). Founder of MR33 (setup tools/additives) via ToniSport. No dedicated tuning-explainer YouTube of his own verified; YouTube hits are third-party interviews.

name: Alexander Hagberg
palmares: 2x IFMAR World Champion; 8x EFRA European Champion; XRAY factory driver
notes: XRAY factory driver with downloadable named setup sheets (e.g. X4 asphalt setup). XRAY released an 'Alexander Hagberg Set-up App'. Runs driver clinics on tire prep and car setup with Jan Ratheisky. Setup sheets are per-event/per-car and updated, not a single fixed publication.

name: Yannic Prümper
palmares: Multiple Worlds A-mains, Euros podiums, ETS Modified wins/podiums; German touring ace; RC MAKER / SP1 driver from 2025
notes: Maintains an official 'Yannic Prümper RC' Facebook page posting races, news and setups. Formerly Infinity IF14, now RC MAKER / SP1. Setups appear via team/aggregator channels. No fixed published book; content is rolling social/setup-sheet posts.

name: Naoto Matsukura
palmares: 5x IFMAR World Championship titles (Touring Car & related), 5x TQ; ex-Yokomo, Tamiya TRF
notes: World-car teardown/setup features on LiveRC ('Inside ... Worlds touring car'). Setups appear within manufacturer/aggregator repositories (Yokomo BD7-era; Tamiya TRF421 via petitrc). No verified personal site/YouTube/fixed guide of his own. Content is car-spec breakdowns and event sheets.

name: Akio Sobue
palmares: Japanese ace; multiple 1/12 Worlds podiums (2x 2nd) and a TQ run; CRC, later AXON / T-Work's / Infinity
notes: Team driver pages (T-Work's) and a LiveRC 'Inside his 1/12 Worlds car' teardown document his setups; Infinity IF14-II TITC 2020 setup sheet on petitrc. Event setup sheets + car breakdowns; no fixed published guide of his own verified.

name: Jan Ratheisky
palmares: IFMAR F1 World Champion (2018, Xray X1)
notes: Contributing world-champion expert to Dave B. Stevens' fixed published book 'Essential 1/12th & F1 RC Racer's Guide' (ISBN 9780648581130), containing step-by-step F1/pan-car setup techniques. No verified personal site/blog/YouTube of his own.

name: David Spashett
palmares: Multiple-time 1/12th IFMAR World Champion (won all three classes at the 1998 On-Road Worlds, England)
notes: Contributing world-champion expert to the fixed published book 'Essential 1/12th & F1 RC Racer's Guide' (1/12 pan-car setup techniques). Also appears in a 'David Spashett Chassis Workshop' YouTube video (RC RACE CAR GP channel) — a one-off explainer, not his own channel.

name: Andy Moore
palmares: IFMAR Electric Touring Car World Champion (2006/2007); multiple ETS/UK titles; HPI, then HB Racing
notes: Downloadable winning HPI Pro 4 setup sheet hosted by HPI; a detailed Hot Bodies World Championship preparation write-up (parts/build prep) on petitrc; ETS/RedRC 'Chassis Focus' interviews. Real published content but not a fixed citable guide.

name: Olly Jefferies
palmares: 11x British Champion; BRCA Modified TC + BRCA Stock 1/12th titles; multiple ETS & IFMAR A-finalist; Xray, then Schumacher
notes: Verified 'Team Associated TC6 — Olly Jefferies Build Tips' (detailed touring-car build/setup tips on petitrc), plus technical R&D interviews on RedRC. CORRECTION: the 'Invisible Speed RC' YouTube channel often associated with him is actually Joseph Quagraine (JQ), NOT Olly Jefferies — no dedicated personal YouTube channel under his own name verified.

name: Christopher Krapp
palmares: Tamiya World Champion (2007); multi-time IFMAR TC Worlds A-finalist; ETS wins/TQs; Kyosho, Tamiya/TRF, then Yokomo factory driver & EU team manager
notes: As Yokomo factory driver/EU team manager, his event setup sheets are on the official Yokomo download page and mirrored in petitrc's per-model archives (BD11/MS2.0). ETS 'Under the Hood' and RedRC 'Chassis Focus' give car-specific tuning detail. Downloadable sheets but not a fixed citable book.
